environment.description: Application deployed on Apache Tomcat 9.0.65 behind an nginx reverse proxy (proxy_pass only, no filtering modules). PostgreSQL 14 database with the service account having SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE privileges on all tables in the public schema. Network: private VPC, no additional middleware between nginx and Tomcat. JVM flags: -Xmx512m -XX:+UseG1GC. The nginx config performs TLS termination and forwards X-Session-Token header unchanged.

config.reverse_proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass, no modsecurity, no lua filtering
config.network: private VPC, no WAF, no IDS/IPS inline
